acquisition_method: The mass spectrometer was operated in positive ionization mode using a data dependent acquisition method.
cleavage_agent: Tryptic digestion was performed for 3 h with 0.1 μg trypsin (Promega Sequencing Grade; Madison, WI) per sample.
fragmentation_method: coupled to an EASY-nLC 1000 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) with both collision induced dissociation (CID) and high energy collision dissociation (HCD) fragmentation.
instrument: A 2-μg aliquot of the peptide mixture was analyzed using a LTQ-Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA)
ionization_type: The mass spectrometer was operated in positive ionization mode
labeling: inferred: No isobaric labels were used in this study.
mass_analyzer: A 2-μg aliquot of the peptide mixture was analyzed using a LTQ-Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer
ptm: Propionylation on N-terminal, Propionylation on Lysines and Phenylisocyanate on N-terminal
